title: Zesty Winey Algerian Turkey Ham Tagine
description: A winey and chewy Algerian dish featuring sashimi-cut turkey ham, perfect for a date night, made sugar-free-friendly and cooked in a bamboo steamer.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of the bamboo steamer over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cumin and coriander and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sashimi-cut turkey ham and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the red wine and chicken broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 20 minutes, or until the liquid has reduced and the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the pitted dates and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs and crusty bread on the side.
